items.title: Patriots claim WR Kobe Prentice off waivers
items.body_text: The Patriots added a wide receiver to their roster on Saturday.
items.author: Josh Alper

items.title: Chiefs rookie Mansoor Delane says his injured shoulder is getting better every day
items.body_text: Chiefs rookie cornerback Mansoor Delane wore a yellow non-contact jersey at his first training camp practice as a result of the shoulder injury he suffered during the offseason.
items.author: Michael David Smith

items.title: Sean McVay on Kyle Shanahan accident: I talked to him, he's got an incredible perspective
items.body_text: Shanahan suffered serious injuries in a car accident and is not able to perform his full coaching duties to start training camp.
items.author: Michael David Smith

items.title: Giants waive linebacker Cam Jones and defensive lineman C.J. Ravenell
items.body_text: The Giants opened up two spots on their 90-player roster ahead of training camp.
items.author: Michael David Smith

items.title: Mike Macdonald on ownership change: "We're entering a new chapter in our organization's history"
items.body_text: The Seahawks opened training camp on Saturday, only two weeks after the organization announced that the team would be sold to a group led by Vinod Khosla, pending league approval.
items.author: Mike Florio

items.title: Trey McBride regrets offseason comments about Cardinals fans
items.body_text: Cardinals tight end Trey McBride had some things to say about Cardinals fans during the offseason.
items.author: Mike Florio

items.title: Mike Macdonald noncommittal on S Nick Emmanwori's availability for Week 1
items.body_text: Seahawks safety Nick Emmanwori required arthroscopic surgery on his right ankle earlier this month.
items.author: Charean Williams

items.title: Ravens DT Nnamdi Madubuike lands on PUP but cleared to return
items.body_text: Ravens defensive tackle Nnamdi Madubuike injured his neck in Week 2 last season and has not seen the field since.
items.author: Charean Williams

items.title: Despite ongoing legal issue, Alaric Jackson will practice with Rams
items.body_text: Even though Rams tackle Alaric Jackson won't be charged with a felony following an offseason domestic battery accusation, he could be entering a diversion program in lieu of a misdemeanor prosecution.
items.author: Mike Florio

items.title: Given the limits of the acclimation period, the NFLPA will check video of Nic Scourton ACL tear
items.body_text: Season-ending injuries are one of the constant risks of training camp, and Panthers linebacker Nic Scourton experienced one on the first day of 2026 practice.
items.author: Mike Florio

items.title: Jets place DL T'Vondre Sweat on the active/non-football injury list
items.body_text: The Jets made three moves on Saturday ahead of the start of training camp next week.
items.author: Charean Williams

items.title: Bears place CB Kyler Gordon on active/PUP and T.J. Edwards on NFI
items.body_text: Bears slot cornerback Kyler Gordon played only three games last season, twice landing on injured reserve.
items.author: Charean Williams

items.title: Patriots second-round LB Gabe Jacas agrees to terms
items.body_text: Second-round linebacker Gabe Jacas did not report to training camp with his Patriots' teammates on Friday.
items.author: Charean Williams

items.title: Rashee Rice's knee is good to go for training camp
items.body_text: Chiefs wide receiver Rashee Rice is cleared for training camp, coach Andy Reid said Friday.
items.author: Charean Williams

items.title: DL Omarr Norman-Lott, TE John Michael Gyllenborg begin Chiefs' camp on active/PUP
items.body_text: Chiefs quarterback Patrick Mahomes and wide receiver Rashee Rice are cleared to participate in the opening of training camp.
items.author: Charean Williams

items.title: Matthew Stafford will have a reduced practice schedule to keep him fresh
items.body_text: Last year, after Rams quarterback Matthew Stafford didn't practice much in training camp due to a back problem, outsiders incorrectly assumed that coach Sean McVay was giving Stafford a break.
items.author: Mike Florio

items.title: 49ers expect Kyle Shanahan to be cleared from concussion long before season opener
items.body_text: The 49ers held their opening news conference Saturday, and General Manager John Lynch was conspicuously alone on the podium.
items.author: Charean Williams

items.title: Bengals place DL B.J. Hill on PUP list
items.body_text: The Bengals are set to open up training camp without defensive tackle B.J.
items.author: Josh Alper

items.title: George Kittle lands on PUP list to open 49ers camp
items.body_text: There's been optimism about tight end George Kittle playing in Week 1 after tearing his Achilles in January, but he's not quite ready to practice yet. 49ers General Manager John Lynch said on Saturday that Kittle will be placed on the physically unable list to open training camp.
items.author: Josh Alper

items.title: Cardinals activate Paris Johnson off the PUP list
items.body_text: After the Cardinals placed left tackle Paris Johnson on the physically unable to perform list this week, head coach Mike LaFleur said that he was dealing with a minor knee injury and would be "back before you know it."
items.author: Josh Alper

items.title: John Lynch on Brandon Aiyuk: We're focused on players that are here
items.body_text: Wide receiver Brandon Aiyuk has had a lot to say this offseason about his desire to play for the Commanders, but the 49ers have not released him and General Manager John Lynch did not make it sound like that is going to happen in the immediate future when he spoke to reporters from the team's training camp on Saturday.
items.author: Josh Alper

items.title: Ty Simpson agrees to rookie deal with Rams
items.body_text: Rams quarterback Ty Simpson started the day as the only 2026 first-round pick without a contract, but that is set to change.
items.author: Josh Alper

items.title: Commanders put Dorance Armstrong, Deatrich Wise on PUP list
items.body_text: The Commanders announced a handful of roster moves before the start of their training camp this week.
items.author: Josh Alper

items.title: Sean McVay: Aaron Donald is putting himself in position to make a decision
items.body_text: Donald is weighing whether or not he will come out of retirement for the 2026 season.
items.author: Josh Alper

items.title: Panthers sign three players, cut three others
items.body_text: The Panthers had several players in for workouts on Friday and that led to some roster shuffling on Saturday.
items.author: Josh Alper

items.title: Robert Kraft: We've offered to make Christian Gonzalez the top-paid cornerback
items.body_text: Cornerback Christian Gonzalez is at Patriots training camp as he continues to talk to the team about a contract extension and Saturday brought some idea of what those conversations have looked like this offseason.
items.author: Josh Alper

items.title: Jordyn Brooks is at the center of the Dolphins' cultural change
items.body_text: The Dolphins have torn apart their roster in an effort to build a team.
items.author: Mike Florio

items.title: Tony Romo's OWI arrest came after he participated in a golf tournament
items.body_text: More details are emerging regarding the arrest of former Cowboys quarterback and current CBS analyst Tony Romo on suspicion of Operating While Intoxicated.
items.author: Mike Florio

items.title: Kyle Shanahan suffered "severe concussion" and other injuries in July 14 car accident
items.body_text: Shanahan will participate in training-camp on a limited basis.
items.author: Mike Florio

items.title: Bill Belichick wants NCAA and NFL playing rules to be standardized
items.body_text: After 50 years in the NFL, Bill Belichick is starting his second season as a college coach.
items.author: Mike Florio
